title: The influence of financial literacy, hedonistic lifestyle, and PayLater on impulse buying through perceived risk
core_idea: Investigate how financial literacy, hedonistic lifestyle orientation, and PayLater (BNPL) usage influence Generation Z students' impulsive online buying, with perceived risk as a mediating cognitive variable, using an explanatory quantitative survey and SEM-PLS analysis.
tldr: Study examines relationships among financial literacy, hedonistic lifestyle, and PayLater use on students' impulsive buying, testing perceived risk as a mediator with survey data (n=100) and SEM-PLS.
